guiding_question: Can I clearly explain where I am trying to grow?
Can I list and demonstrate relevant skills?
Do I have visible proof of applied work?
Can I explain my value clearly?
Do I have people who can guide or advise me?
Am I visible to people connected to opportunities?
Are my CV profile and examples ready to share?
Can I discuss my work and learning journey confidently?
Do I have a routine for growth and improvement?
Can I adapt when plans change or opportunities fail?
